persons.name: Cakrarāja
persons.evidence: dharaṇi,vibudhaś cakrarājaḥ sudhīraḥ śukle pakṣe vividharacanaṃ lekhayāmāsa

date.as_written: kāle dyocāraṇavikalite, śuddhanepālaśāke, māghe māse śaśadharadine ... śrīpañcamyāṃ ... śukle pakṣe

notes: The catalogue lists Cakrarāja as scribe, but the causative verb 'lekhayāmāsa' indicates he commissioned the manuscript. The epithet 'dharaṇivibudha' designates him as a Brahmin.
